title: Spatial transcriptomics meets diabetic kidney disease: Illuminating the path to precision medicine.
authors: Liu, Dan-Dan; Hu, Han-Yue; Li, Fei-Fei; Hu, Qiu-Yue; Liu, Ming-Wei; Hao, You-Jin; Li, Bo
one_liner_zh: 该文综述空间转录组学在糖尿病肾病中的应用，虽提及转录因子但无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Diabetic kidney disease (DKD), a primary cause of end-stage renal disease, results from progressive tissue remodeling and loss of kidney function. While single-cell RNA sequencing has significantly accelerated our understanding of cellular diversity and dynamics in DKD, its lack of spatial resolution limits insights into tissue-specific dysregulation and the microenvironment. Spatial transcriptomics (ST) is an innovative technology that combines gene expression with spatial localization, offering a powerful approach to dissect the molecular mechanisms of DKD. This mini-review introduces how ST has transformed DKD research by enabling spatially resolved analysis of cell interactions and identifying localized molecular alterations in glomeruli and tubules. ST has revealed dynamic intercellular communication within the renal microenvironment, lesion-specific gene expression patterns, and immune infiltration profiles. For example, Slide-seqV2 has highlighted disease-specific cellular neighborhoods and associated signaling networks. Furthermore, ST has pinpointed key genes implicated in disease progression, such as fibrosis-related proteins and transcription factors in tubular damage. By integration of ST with computational tools such as machine learning and network-based analysis can help uncover gene regulatory mechanisms and potential therapeutic targets. However, challenges remain in limited spatial resolution, high data complexity, and computational demands. Addressing these limitations is essential for advancing precision medicine in DKD.
abstract_zh: 糖尿病肾病（DKD）是终末期肾病的主要原因，源于进行性组织重塑和肾功能丧失。尽管单细胞RNA测序显著加速了我们对DKD中细胞多样性和动态变化的理解，但其缺乏空间分辨率，限制了对组织特异性失调和微环境的洞察。空间转录组学（ST）是一种将基因表达与空间定位相结合的创新技术，为解析DKD的分子机制提供了有力手段。本小型综述介绍了ST如何通过实现细胞相互作用的空间分辨分析以及识别肾小球和肾小管中局部分子改变，从而变革DKD研究。ST揭示了肾微环境内的动态细胞间通讯、病变特异性基因表达模式及免疫浸润谱。例如，Slide-seqV2突出了疾病特异性细胞邻域及相关信号网络。此外，ST精确定位了与疾病进展相关的关键基因，如纤维化相关蛋白和肾小管损伤中的转录因子。通过将ST与机器学习及基于网络的分析等计算工具整合，有助于揭示基因调控机制和潜在治疗靶点。然而，挑战依然存在，包括有限的空间分辨率、高数据复杂性和计算需求。解决这些局限性对于推进DKD的精准医学至关重要。
